sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14895 of 2022

Applicant :- Hasan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru Prin. Secy. Home
Counsel for Applicant :- Abrar Ahmad,Arshad Jameel,Mohd. Salman,Mukhtar Ahamad,Rakesh K.

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.164 of 2022, under Sections 452, 354, 376,
511, 323, 504, 506 Ipc, Police Station Sadatganj, District Lucknow.

3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that on 18.07.2022, when the informant was going to her mother's home, the applicant tried to misbehave her and on reaching at mother's home, the applicant tore her cloths and tried to commit rape and when her husband and mother came, a fight also took place in between the applicant and her husband.

In the statement under Section 161 of Hasan vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin. Secy. Home on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33491094/
1 Cr.P.C., the victim disclosed her age as 26 years and she reiterated the version of the FIR.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she stated that she was being harassed by the applicant and used to threaten her.
It was also stated that the act of violence in the form of attacking her with a blade was also done in the year 2019.
She also stated that the applicant misbehaved with her.
No allegation of actual rape being committed were levelled against the applicant.
There is not medical report on record to corroborate the allegation.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that prima facie, apart from the statements, which too are inconsistent, there are nothing on record to support the prosecution story coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 18.07.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Hasan be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 akverma  Hasan vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin. Secy. Home on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33491094/
